card.name: Setting up folksy 'mother' remarks
card.fires_on: Short linking or possessive words such as our, your, we, what, way and and, at the start of a general-health statement where a reference to mothers or common folk wisdom could come next.

modes.label: Our/Your opening a sentence
modes.description: A possessive such as Our or Your starts a general statement about the body or health habits.
modes.example: Most of these bacteria are harmless, but some can make you very sick.<< Our>> hands are usually one of the germiest

modes.label: Linking word in folk wisdom
modes.description: A small linking word sits in a phrase about what we were taught or what family elders knew.
modes.example: Fortunately, some good researchers now stand up for the body’s innate healing tactics, which our mothers<< and>> grandmothers had known about all along

modes.label: Lead-in to a quoted saying
modes.description: A word such as As introduces a familiar saying attributed to Mom.
modes.example: And there's not a thing wrong with that, once in a while.<< As>> Mom always said, "When you're
